name: TCA Venture Group (formerly Tech Coast Angels)
description: Southern California angel network, founded 1997, approximately 400 members in six regional networks (Orange County, Los Angeles, Pasadena Angels, Inland Empire, Florida/Georgia) plus five angel funds. Over 540 companies funded and more than $300 million invested in seed and early A rounds. Members invest individually; funds may add capital. Syndicates with 50+ angel groups via the Angel Syndication Network.
reachable_investors: Chapter leaders named on site pages; no individual handles published. Contact for entrepreneur questions: laura.beken@tcavg.com (listed on the apply page).
cost: Free. No application or presentation fee is stated on the site (checked the apply page and entrepreneur page).
how_to_apply_or_post: Open online application at https://tcaventuregroup.com/apply-for-funding-now/ . Click the network you are applying to; you are routed to a deal platform (Spark or Startup Steroid), create a venture profile, upload pitch deck. Process: application -> pre-screen (feedback given) -> screening session -> due diligence. Seeks US/Canada companies, CA preference; earlier page states raises of $50,000 to $1,000,000; site says TCA can invest 'up to several million dollars' via funds, members and syndicate partners.
geography: Southern California primary; US and Canada accepted; California preference.
typical_outcome: Seed, bridge, early Series A. Historic guidance $50K-$1M per raise from TCA; larger via syndication. Deals per year and decision time not stated.
notes: Requires 'some level of market validation' and defensible model; pre-revenue idea-stage founders are unlikely fits. Applicants get access to a perks package (AWS, Google Cloud credits, etc.). techcoastangels.com redirects to tcaventuregroup.com.

name: Golden Seeds
description: National US angel network founded 2004 that invests only in women-led, US-domiciled startups. 9 chapters, members in 28 states plus DC and abroad, 1,150+ total investors, 275+ companies funded, $200M invested, $2.5B+ follow-on capital. Also runs member-managed annual funds and professionally managed venture funds.
reachable_investors: Co-CEO Jo Ann Corkran named in news; no individual investor handles published.
cost: Non-refundable $50 application fee ('There is a non-refundable $50 fee to cover our administrative costs for the application').
how_to_apply_or_post: Apply via Dealum: https://app.dealum.com/#/company/application/new/64232/nmsxipihuv86m21z2xcympea251hqago (linked from https://www.goldenseeds.com/how-to-apply). Application asks for elevator pitch, problem, solution, TAM, business model, GTM, competition, team, financial summary and 3-year projection, funding history, use of funds, valuation and amount sought. Free monthly info sessions and office hours exist for founders before applying.
geography: United States (company must be US-domiciled); chapters in multiple US cities.
typical_outcome: Typical first rounds $250K-$2M, valuations under $10M, exit expected within 5-8 years. Deals per year and decision time not stated.
notes: Eligibility: woman in CEO/founder or other executive role with a 'fair' amount of equity. Wants product in beta stage with 'proof of concept' revenue or significant pilots (except bio/pharma, diagnostics, devices). Idea-stage pre-product companies do not meet criteria. Pay-to-apply ($50) is small but exists.

name: Keiretsu Forum
description: Self-described world's largest angel investor network, 50+ chapters worldwide (US, Canada, Europe, India, Middle East, Asia, Australia). Members are accredited investors who invest individually; the forum is a facilitation service and takes no warrants or commissions in the US/Canada. Northwest & Rockies region alone reports 393 members, 145 companies funded in 2025, $84.7M invested, average $584K per company.
reachable_investors: Regional entrepreneur contacts published on the apply page, e.g. Northern California: Lauren Anderson; Mid-Atlantic: Howard Lubert; Mumbai: Mahinder Chugh (mahinder@keiretsuforum.com); Chennai/Singapore: Rajan Srikanth (srikanth@keiretsuforum.com); Central Canada: Ozan Isinak (ozan@keiretsuforum.ca); Nordics: Disa Ohlander (disa@keiretsuforumnordics.com). Northwest head of deal flow: Kahaan Shah (kahaan@k4northwest.com).
cost: PAY-TO-PITCH. Free to apply, to be pre-screened, and to present at Deal Screening. If selected to present to the full Forum, an 'administrative fee' is charged ('there is an administrative fee in order to defer a portion of the management and organizational costs. Also, the administrative fee serves as filter system'). The amount is NOT published on the site; it is set per chapter ('Please contact the Entrepreneur Director of the chapter'). Amount unverified as of 2026-09-02.
how_to_apply_or_post: Open application per region at https://www.keiretsuforum.com/apply-to-present/ . Most regions use Dealum forms (e.g. Northwest: https://app.dealum.com/#/company/application/new/47381/diszns8ldr0s5tjkozubkpi889bw2xj7). Process: application -> committee pre-screen -> Deal Screening (15-min pitch, 10 slides, 15-20 members vote, 7-10 companies) -> 4-5 selected for full Forum (20-min pitch) -> Gold Sheet interest list -> due diligence. Attend a meeting as a guest first (recommended). No NDAs signed.
contacts: randy@keiretsuforum.com (global chapters page); events@keiretsuforum.com; kahaan@k4northwest.com; regional emails listed above.
geography: Global, 50+ chapters; apply to the nearest chapter first, then multi-chapter roadshow.
typical_outcome: Rounds $250K-$2M; individual member checks $25K-$500K. Northwest 2025: average $584K per funded company, 83% of presenters funded (self-reported). Decision after Deal Screening within one day; full cycle typically months.
notes: NOT for idea stage: 'typically in their A or B rounds, usually having already raised $500K to $1.5m from founders, friends, and family... Most... have some revenue'. Northwest chapter requires $750K+ revenue (or clinical-trial stage / TRL 6-7) and prior angel fundraising. Widely criticized as pay-to-pitch; the site itself calls the fee a 'filter system'.

name: New York Angels
description: One of the oldest US angel groups (20+ years), NYC-based. $180M+ invested in 360+ companies. Members invest individually; NYA also has a fund that can add to member dollars and can lead rounds with its own documents. Hears live pitches from 10+ entrepreneurs each month.
reachable_investors: Member list is on the site (Angels > New York Angels Members); no handles extracted.
cost: Free. FAQ: 'Are there fees involved in submitting to the New York Angels? No.'
how_to_apply_or_post: Apply on Gust: https://gust.com/organizations/new-york-angels/public_profile (all applicants must use Gust). Applications reviewed by Pre-Screening and Screening committees, then monthly Screening pitch, 2-hour Discovery meeting, due diligence, term sheet. A member referral helps but is not required; include it in the application if you have one. Flash-deal track for companies with a signed term sheet and one NYA member committed.
contacts: info@newyorkangels.com; address 1216 Broadway, Floor 2, New York, NY 10001
geography: New York City / Northeast focus; reach now national and international.
typical_outcome: Investment per deal $100K-$1.5M, median around $500K. Average time from application to funding 2-3 months; flash deals under one month.
notes: Sectors: life sciences, medtech, SaaS, fintech, consumer, gaming, AI, cleantech, advanced materials. Expects protected IP and exit strategy with 10x potential. Syndicates with other Northeast angel groups.

name: HBS Alumni Angels Association (HBSAA) and chapters (Greater New York, Northern California)
description: Global network of Harvard alumni angel investors: 20 chapters, 1,000+ members, 440 companies funded, $110M invested (national site). Founders apply through a local chapter. Greater NY chapter: 300+ angels, $40M+ in 150+ companies, monthly pitch nights, sector leads in 25+ sectors. Northern California chapter: quarterly pitch events, selection committee reviews 40+ deals per quarter and invites 4-6 to present.
reachable_investors: Chapter chairs are named on https://www.hbsangels.com/chapters (e.g. New York chair Jason E. Klein; Northern California co-chairs Yasemin Kliman and Tony Lazar; Boston chair Matthew H Hagen). NY chapter publishes a member directory page.
cost: No application fee stated on the national, NY, or Northern California pages (unverified for other chapters).
how_to_apply_or_post: No Harvard affiliation required ('Accepting Startup pitches from the best entrepreneurs around the world -- no Harvard Affiliation required'). Apply via chapter Gust pages: Greater NY https://gust.com/organizations/hbs-new-york/public_profile (from https://www.hbsangelsny.com/apply-to-pitch); Northern California https://gust.com/organizations/hbsaa-nc/apply; Washington DC https://gust.com/organizations/harvard-business-school-club-of-washington-dc. Other chapter links on the chapters page. Member referrals encouraged but not required.
contacts: angels@hbscny.org (Greater NY chapter); national mailing address 369-B Third Street #703, San Rafael, CA 94901
geography: Global: US chapters (Boston, NY, Northern California, Southern California, Chicago, Houston, Charlotte, South Florida, DC) and international (UK, France, Germany, Sweden, India, Singapore, China, Korea, Thailand, Brazil, GCC).
typical_outcome: Members invest individually in a common round; NY chapter says members close a new round monthly and about one third of investments are follow-ons. Check sizes not published.
notes: Boston chapter site (angels-hbsab.org) returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-02; not verified. hbsalumniangels.com redirects to hbsangels.com. Investor membership requires Harvard affiliation; founder applications do not.

name: Band of Angels
description: Silicon Valley's oldest seed angel group (founded 1994), 150+ members, 400+ deals and $400M+ invested since 1994, 17 IPOs and 97 M&As. Reviews 1,000+ deals per year; pre-screening committee reviews 50+ startups a month and selects 6 for Deal Screening (last Wednesday monthly), then Deal Dinner. In 2025 invested in 15 startups (10 new, 5 follow-on).
reachable_investors: Chairman Ian Sobieski, PhD; Executive Director Asli Gozoren; deal-screening leads named on the About page (e.g. Ron Collett software, Mike Maszy life sciences). No handles.
cost: Free. 'There are no fees to submit or present to the Band of Angels.'
how_to_apply_or_post: Open company application on Dealum: https://app.dealum.com/#/company/application/new/241195/w31why1f9zpjgiiwo07efxipweoyy4p0 (from https://www.bandangels.com/apply-to-present). Submit PDF documents only; use the Band one-pager template. Do not send confidential info; no NDAs.
geography: Silicon Valley, San Francisco, Los Angeles; US-registered entities only.
typical_outcome: Investment size $300K-$750K; stage pre-seed to Series A; preferred valuation/cap around $10M. 2-3 months to close if Band leads; members have invested within 24 hours of a Deal Dinner in syndicated deals.
notes: Technology and life sciences only; no real estate, restaurants, funds. Explicitly lists 'Pre-Seed' as a stage, so early founders can apply.

name: IAN Group (Indian Angel Network)
description: India's largest horizontal early-stage platform (founded 2006): IAN Angel Fund (SEBI Category I angel fund, evergreen), BioAngels, IAN Fund 1, and $100M IAN Alpha Fund. ~Rs 1,500 crore invested in 270+ companies across 28 sectors; investor base across 12 countries. Enables raises from Rs 50 lakh to Rs 50 crore.
reachable_investors: Fund contacts published: smriti@iangroup.vc (IAN Angel Fund), sanat@iangroup.vc (IAN Alpha Fund), ir@iangroup.vc (investor relations).
cost: Not stated on the site; the site has a 'Refund & Cancellation Policy' page, which suggests some paid service exists, but no founder fee was found. Unverified.
how_to_apply_or_post: Open 'Submit Plan' form at https://iangroup.vc/submit-plan/ (form renders in-browser; fields not visible to a text fetch). Sector-agnostic; deeptech, AI, spacetech, biotech, SaaS, robotics, fintech, healthtech, consumer.
geography: India (New Delhi HQ); investors in 12 countries; also overseas startup exposure.
typical_outcome: Rounds from Rs 50 lakh upward; recent IAN Angel Fund leads of Rs 4-12.5 crore (2026 news items). Decision time not stated.
notes: indianangelnetwork.com redirects to iangroup.vc. Site has visible template placeholder text ('bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb'), so some pages are under maintenance. Disclaimer: IANPL 'acts as an introducer'.

name: Mumbai Angels (part of 360 ONE)
description: Mumbai-based angel network founded 2006, acquired by 360 ONE (wealth/alternates firm). Archived site (Dec 2024 / Mar 2025) states 650+ investors, 200+ deals, INR 200 crore invested from 60 cities across 10 countries, 100+ exits, 35% composite IRR. All investments route through Mumbai Angels Fund-1 (SEBI angel fund).
reachable_investors: unknown
cost: Founder fees not found. Investor side: one-time INR 50,000 subscriber fee and INR 25 lakh minimum commitment per LP over 5 years (archived FAQ).
how_to_apply_or_post: Archived site has a 'Founders' / 'FundRaising' section with an on-site form. LIVE SITE NOT VERIFIED: on 2026-09-02 the live site returned a Cloudflare block (HTTP 403) to two different fetchers, and the Internet Archive snapshot dated 2026-05-15 for the homepage contained unrelated casino spam content. Treat the domain status as uncertain; confirm via 360 ONE before you submit data. Contact email from archive: investments@360.one.
geography: India (Mumbai HQ), pan-India investors.
typical_outcome: Ticket size not published in the pages read. Decision time unknown.
notes: CAUTION: possible domain hijack or CDN misconfiguration observed in the 2026-05-15 archive snapshot. Data here is from 2024-2025 archive snapshots, not the live site.

name: LetsVenture / LVX (lvxventures.com)
description: India's largest online early-stage investing platform (letsventure.com now redirects to lvxventures.com). Self-reported: 36K+ platform investors, 300+ family offices and funds, Rs 1,160+ crore committed, 715+ deals. Products: LVX Start (early-stage syndicates via LV Angel Fund), LVX Grow (growth-stage), lead-investor syndicates, LetsVenture Debt, LV Elite Studio (6-week investor-readiness cohort), founder programs (Fuel, Varsity, WIN).
reachable_investors: Lead investors run named syndicates on the platform; names visible only after login. No public handles.
cost: Free to sign up; success fee after closing. FAQ: 'LetsVenture charges a fee to the Startup based on the funds being raised on the platform and upto 5% carry from Investors' and 'the platform is free to any Startup to sign up and the fee is charged only after successful deal closure'. Exact percentage not published.
how_to_apply_or_post: Create a startup profile at https://app.lvxventures.com/intro/startup (from the 'Raise Funds for My Startup' link). Founder page: https://lvxventures.com/founders. Fundraise typically needs a lead investor who commits 10-15% of the round and sets valuation; LVX and lead run legal/financial diligence once 80% of commitments are in; funds flow through the LV Angel Fund.
contacts: unknown (contact form at https://lvxventures.com/contact-us; Bangalore office address published)
geography: India (Bangalore HQ); also a Dubai corridor program.
typical_outcome: Rounds close via syndicates; ticket sizes vary by lead. Decision time not stated.
notes: Warning on site: letsventurecredit.com is a fraud site impersonating LetsVenture. Lead syndicates can charge 0-15% carry.

name: Angel Capital Association (ACA) Member Directory
description: Trade association of North American angel groups and accredited platforms. The public directory lists ACA member groups and platforms (sortable/filterable by state and focus) and links to each group's site. ACA itself does not fund companies; individual members are not listed.
reachable_investors: Not applicable; the directory lists organizations, not individuals.
cost: Free to browse. ACA warns founders to check fees: 'It is an important part of any diligence process to understand what, if any, fees or costs extend to entrepreneurs for investor group presentations or platform participation.'
how_to_apply_or_post: Use the directory to find groups by state and sector, then apply on each group's own site. ACA also has an entrepreneurs page: https://angelcapitalassociation.org/entrepreneurs/.
contacts: sdickey@angelcapitalassociation.org (contact link on the directory page)
geography: United States and Canada (plus some international affiliates).
typical_outcome: Not applicable (directory).
notes: Most groups listed here use Gust or Dealum for applications. A fuller directory is members-only.

name: Sand Hill Angels
description: Silicon Valley angel group since 2000 with over 145 members (technology entrepreneurs, executives, some VCs). Invests seed to Series B in scalable technology. Special Interest Groups (Consumer, Enterprise, Life Sciences) screen deals monthly; new presenters chosen every month.
reachable_investors: Members page exists on site; no handles extracted.
cost: No fee stated on the site (not explicitly confirmed).
how_to_apply_or_post: Application required via Dealum: https://app.dealum.com#/company/application/new/40860/7dbf91x28xgnzw3r8zkegwom3jbk9w4x (the only route; 'requires an application via our deal management platform'). Applications accepted throughout the month; SIG review -> Screening Committee -> first pitch (last Thursday of month) -> 2nd pitch (2nd Thursday) -> due diligence. Investment tips PDF on the Investment page. Also runs 'Sand Hill Angels RAW' pitch-practice sessions.
geography: Silicon Valley / San Francisco Bay Area.
typical_outcome: Check size not published. No set diligence timeline. Quarterly updates expected post-investment.
notes: Primarily seed and later; pre-seed idea-stage fit is unclear.

name: Houston Angel Network (HAN)
description: Houston, Texas angel network. Monthly pitch meetings (except July and December); three companies pitch per meeting (8 min pitch + 5 min Q&A). Deal committees: Energy, Life Sciences, Consumer, Tech, Aerospace. Members invest individually or via SPV; HAN itself does not invest.
reachable_investors: unknown
cost: $100 application fee ('The Houston Angel Network charges an application fee of $100'); does not guarantee a pitch. If an SPV is formed the company pays the SPV formation fee.
how_to_apply_or_post: Pay the fee, then apply on Dealum: https://app.dealum.com/#/company/application/new/75065/4vt3ucfn5yfihc2hc3t88omljok8aawt . Apply at least one month before the target pitch date. Steps: apply -> deal committee review (last week of month) -> internal selection vote (first Wednesday) -> pitch meeting (third Wednesday) -> individual follow-ups and diligence. Free readiness self-evaluation tool on the page.
contacts: unknown (no email published on the entrepreneurs page)
geography: Houston, Texas.
typical_outcome: Stages pre-seed, seed, bridge, Series A. Check size not published. Monthly cycle.
notes: Requires a completed working prototype and market validation (pilot, beta users, or revenue). No NDAs. Pay-to-apply ($100).

name: Central Texas Angel Network (CTAN)
description: Austin, Texas nonprofit angel network founded 2006; 140 accredited members; $142.4M invested in 233 companies; 57 exits; six funding cycles per year with pitch nights. Also runs Founder Angel Speed Dating (10-minute mentoring sessions) 5x per year and free founder info sessions.
reachable_investors: unknown (member confidentiality policy)
cost: No application fee found on the entrepreneurs, FAQ, criteria or funding-cycle pages. Benefits package of $850K in startup credits for all applicants.
how_to_apply_or_post: Apply on Dealum: https://app.dealum.com/#/company/application/new/72264/cmwl94en1rop0rvg8k9x44vzlcw2hgrf before a cycle deadline (2026 deadlines: Jan 18, Mar 15, Jul 26, Sep 6, Oct 18). Cycle: pre-cycle screening -> virtual pitch event -> Pitch Night -> diligence. Accepts preferred equity, capped convertible notes, capped post-money SAFEs only. Not required to be in Texas.
geography: Austin / Central Texas; companies outside Texas considered.
typical_outcome: Pre-seed, seed, Series A. Average pre-money valuation for pre-seed/seed deals $4.72M; Series A $11.01M. Each cycle at least six weeks.
notes: Explicitly lists Pre-Seed. Wants at least one full-time founder, rarely single-person companies, 3+ months runway. No lifestyle businesses, franchises, real estate, consulting.

name: Launchpad Venture Group
description: Boston-area angel group investing in early-stage science or tech companies headquartered in New England. Two tracks: 'Catalyst' casual pitch event (8-10 startups, short pitch, relationship building) and 'Main Forum' for companies raising a priced equity round of $500K-$2M, with a 4-5 investor scouting team.
reachable_investors: Managing Director Raza Shaikh quoted on site; team page exists.
cost: No fee stated on the entrepreneurs page (not explicitly confirmed).
how_to_apply_or_post: 'Apply for Launchpad Funding' link goes to Dealum dealroom https://app.dealum.com/#/dealroom/28890 . Site encourages contacting Launchpad investors online and at community events before applying.
geography: New England, USA (HQ requirement).
typical_outcome: Pre-Seed, Seed or Series A priced equity rounds; Main Forum rounds $500K-$2M. Timing not stated.
notes: Requires priced equity round (not SAFE) and market of $100M+. Catalyst track is a lighter on-ramp suitable for earlier companies.

name: Alliance of Angels (AoA)
description: Largest angel group in the Pacific Northwest (Seattle), 180+ accredited members, invests individually and via an Innovation Fund. Meets ~30 companies a month, 6 go to the Screening Committee (~15 active angels), 3 present to the full member meeting (80-90 members in person). Invests in 20+ deals per year; 40% of companies presenting at member meetings get funded (self-reported).
reachable_investors: Leadership page exists; no handles extracted.
cost: No fee stated on the criteria/process page.
how_to_apply_or_post: 'APPLY FOR FUNDING' button on https://www.allianceofangels.com/investment-criteria-and-process (on-site form; target link not extractable from HTML). Process: introductory meeting with AoA staff -> screening meeting -> member meeting -> diligence targeted within 5 weeks of screening. Bring an investor deck. Email for returning pitch companies: updates@allianceofangels.com.
contacts: aoa@allianceofangels.com; updates@allianceofangels.com; 719 2nd Ave Ste 1000, Seattle, WA 98104
geography: Pacific Northwest; invests only in US/Canada-headquartered C-corps.
typical_outcome: Seed and early stage; most first rounds $500K-$2.5M. Can lead rounds. Diligence target ~5 weeks after screening.
notes: No LLCs, S-corps or nonprofits; excludes gambling, alcohol, firearms, mining, tobacco/vaping, cannabis.

name: Pasadena Angels
description: Pasadena, California angel group founded 2000, 100+ members, 250+ companies funded; a member network of TCA Venture Group and syndicates with the six TCA regional groups. Monthly funding cycles with pre-screen, screening, and final presentation at a company evaluation meeting.
reachable_investors: unknown
cost: Free. 'We do not charge the entrepreneurs an application fee'.
how_to_apply_or_post: 'Apply Here' / 'Apply for Funding' on the entrepreneurs and FAQ pages (routes through the TCA deal platform; mention any PA/TCA member referral). Specify deal terms and upload financial projections. Only preferred equity, convertible notes, or post-money SAFEs.
geography: California primary; US and Canada accepted; US-based C-corp (or Canadian equivalent).
typical_outcome: Invests $100K-$1M typically ($150K-$750K per criteria page); PA fund may add $100K when four members invest $100K+. Valuation caps $1M-$15M, single-digit millions preferred. 1-2 months to close after final presentation.
notes: Stage Seed+: needs MVP or working prototype and customer discovery; 'From time to time, we invest in a late pre-seed stage'. Idea-stage without MVP not funded. No NDAs.

name: Boston Harbor Angels
description: Boston angel group since 2004 investing in IT, life sciences, consumer, business products, materials, aviation and more. Reviews 100+ plans monthly, selects eight for the screening meeting, four for the General Investor Meeting. Also runs the Active Fund and EQX Fund.
reachable_investors: Management team page exists; no handles extracted.
cost: PAY-TO-PITCH: 'There is a one-time fee of $400 if invited to present at the General Investor Meeting.' Applying is free.
how_to_apply_or_post: Apply on Gust: https://gust.com/organizations/boston-harbor-angels/apply . Process: application -> screening meeting (10-min pitch + 20-min Q&A, feedback) -> General Investor Meeting (non-confidential deck advised) -> interest sheets -> due diligence team -> term sheet.
geography: Boston / New England.
typical_outcome: Check size not published. Monthly cycle.
notes: $400 presentation fee applies only if selected for the general meeting.

name: The Chennai Angels (TCA)
description: Chennai, India angel group with 150+ investors, Rs 150+ crore invested, 80+ startups funded. Four-stage process: prescreening and investor presentation -> deep-dive evaluation -> term sheet and due diligence -> closure.
reachable_investors: unknown
cost: Free to apply. For deals invested: 'deal facilitation fee of 2.5% of the total funds raised' plus due diligence costs at actuals.
how_to_apply_or_post: Register and upload deck on the platform https://tca.thechennaiangels.com/login (Entrepreneur Login / 'Apply for funding'). Use the required presentation format. Email connect@thechennaiangels.com if the platform fails.
geography: Chennai / South India; pan-India startups.
typical_outcome: Average ticket Rs 50 lakh to Rs 3 crore; larger rounds syndicated. Process takes 4-6 months.
notes: Eligibility: 'Early revenue stage startups' with proprietary tech and early traction; idea-stage pre-revenue is not a fit. Plans are shared with members without NDA.

name: Hyderabad Angels
description: Hyderabad, India angel network (Hyderabad Angels Forum for Entrepreneurship): 100+ investors, 75+ investments, 15+ exits, 14+ years; seed-stage tech and seed-plus growth companies in India and USA (archived site, Oct-Dec 2025).
reachable_investors: Marquee investors named on the archived homepage (e.g. Srinivasa Raju Chintalapati, Pradeep Mittal, Suresh Daggubati); no handles.
cost: Not stated.
how_to_apply_or_post: 'Submit your Plan' form on https://hyderabadangels.in/startups/ (archived copy). LIVE SITE NOT VERIFIED: returned HTTP 429 (rate limit) on two attempts on 2026-09-02; data is from Internet Archive snapshots of 2025-10-14 and 2025-12-14.
geography: Hyderabad, India; invests across India and USA.
typical_outcome: Ticket size not published. Prefers asset-light businesses with existing customer and revenue traction.
notes: Revenue traction preferred; idea stage is a weak fit. Verify live site before you apply.

name: Inflection Point Ventures (IPV)
description: India's largest CXO/HNI angel platform (Gurgaon HQ): independent forum of over 2,500 CXOs and HNIs (startup FAQ) who invest via a designated lead member and pooled structures; single point of contact for the startup; feedback report after the pitch webinar; handholding to Series A.
reachable_investors: unknown
cost: Success fee after selection: 'we do charge a nominal amount to cover the administrative and other evaluation-related costs. This is a mutually agreed upon % of total amount raised via IPV'. Percentage disclosed only after the voting stage.
how_to_apply_or_post: Open forms linked from the homepage 'I'm a Startup' slider: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/RN0MmexeLY and https://forms.gle/8cHv6XFmJSBMh1rf7 . Startup FAQ: https://ipventures.in/startups-faqs/ . Process: application -> screening -> pitch webinar to members -> member voting -> fee agreement -> lead-member term negotiation -> SHA/SSA.
contacts: marcom@ipventures.in; office 239, 2nd Floor Tower A, JMD Megapolis, Sector 48, Sohna Road, Gurgaon 122018
geography: India (pan-India), some cross-border.
typical_outcome: Recent news on site: seed and pre-seed leads of Rs 4.7-8 crore and a $100,000 seed lead. Decision time not stated.
notes: Takes standard rights (drag/tag, ROFR, pre-emptive). Fee is a percent of funds raised, agreed after members vote.

name: Venture Catalysts++ (VCats)
description: Mumbai-based multi-stage investment platform and angel fund (Venture Catalysts Angel Growth Fund). Claims 10,000+ investor community, 400+ startups backed in 10 years, support from pre-seed to Series B, presence in 90% of Indian districts. Runs pitch events (DDay, Global Pitch Day, Investor Fuel).
reachable_investors: unknown
cost: Not stated on the FAQ or form pages.
how_to_apply_or_post: Open application form at https://www.venturecatalysts.in/Form . Fields: startup name, website, description, sector, HQ, founder LinkedIns, full-time status, email, phone, stage (Ideation / Pre-Seed / Seed / Pre-Series A / Series A / Growth), current monthly MRR, prior funding, amount sought, pitch deck (PDF/PPT, 20MB), product demo video (50MB), testimonials.
contacts: unknown (phone 022-69010115 / 022-69010116 listed; email obfuscated on page)
geography: India (Mumbai HQ), nationwide.
typical_outcome: Ticket size not published. Decision time not stated.
notes: The form accepts 'Ideation' and 'Pre-Seed' stages, so idea-stage founders can submit.

name: 100X.VC
description: Mumbai-based early-stage investor that pioneered the iSAFE (India Simple Agreement for Future Equity) in July 2019; invests in 'Moonshot Ideas' at idea/MVP/early-revenue stage in cohorts ('classes'). Milestones on site: 400+ founders, 180 companies, $90M+ follow-on funding, 2,010 jobs.
reachable_investors: Team page at https://www.100x.vc/team (names not extracted).
cost: Not stated. iSAFE templates are free downloads.
how_to_apply_or_post: No apply link was found on the current site (homepage, /about, /team, /isafe only; /apply returns 404 as of 2026-09-02). Historically 100X.VC ran open class applications; the current application route is unverified. Use iSAFE docs at https://www.100x.vc/isafe .
geography: India (Mumbai).
typical_outcome: iSAFE investments at very early stage; check size not published on current site.

geography: Cambridge, UK ('Silicon Fen') and wider UK; tech and healthcare.
typical_outcome: Check sizes not published on pages read. Timing not stated.
notes: Membership is invitation-only for investors; founder applications are open.

name: Angel Investment Network (UK) - paid listing platform
description: Online matching marketplace connecting entrepreneurs with self-registered angel investors; UK site plus 40 country networks, claims 300,000+ investors worldwide. Founders create a pitch listing; investors browse and express interest.

'Money back guarantee' if no genuine interest. Free to join as an investor.

name: 37 Angels
description: New York network of women angel investors (education-focused; runs investor bootcamps). Invests $50-200K per company as a network (most angels $25K each). Every 2 months, 8 companies out of ~500 applicants pitch; single point of contact for founders.
